verdict.rationale: Sardine's getting-started docs tell users to request access to a sandbox dashboard account, so a first-party sandbox environment exists. The evidence is a single thin mention and does not describe how the sandbox works or how it is isolated from production. missing for 10: documented sandbox API endpoints/keys, explicit separation from production data, test data or simulated scenarios, self-serve (non-request) access, independent or hands-on corroboration.
